_about: Colour variant generator. A variant maps each tool ROLE to a palette colour (config/colors.json). Geometry is never rebuilt for a colour change: the same per-tool STLs are re-packed into a new 3MF + preview. A variant may leave a tool as null = 'use whatever toolheads.json says is loaded'. Specialty (tool_4) may be forced by a product's material requirement (e.g. TPU pads) - validation reports conflicts.
